newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE FANS SHOOT THREE AFTER UNITED VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE FANS SHOOT THREE AFTER UNITED VICTORY.

text.p: Turkish soccer fans shot and injured three people, including a 10-month-old baby, while celebrating Fenerbahce's historic win over Manchester United on Wednesday night.
A 25-year-old man firing randomly out of his window in jubilation shot a woman in the stomach and her 10-month baby in the feet, the state-run Anatolian news agency said.
The mother and son, who were were sitting on their balcony at the time, were rushed to hospital.
In a separate incident, an 18-year-old youth was shot in the neck by a stray bullet while peering over his balcony to watch ecstatic Fenerbahce fans celebrating in the streets.
Fenerbahce beat Manchester United 1-0 on the English team's home turf -- the first home loss for United in 40 years of European competition.
